name: Creator essay
genre: creator essay / explainer in a real room, type in the world
identity: One person thinking out loud in a real place, and the place answers: the argument is written ON the room (a floor under a long shadow, a desk, a wall), BEHIND the things in it (a laptop, a calendar, a mic), and ON the person (a fingertip card, words orbiting the head, type along an outline). Every line gets its own trick; nothing repeats. The invention is per story: these are the bar, not a recipe.

abstain_when: podcast with two or more speakers

structure.note: a line written into the room before we know who speaks
the speaker states the idea; the idea gets a body
one world device per proof, each attached to what the proof is about
the room changes: a black-and-white SECTION, one colour kept, or a silhouette hold
the line the piece exists for, written once, large, in the world (a dissolve only when the line speaks of vanishing or light)

type_voices.name: room
type_voices.use: type on planes: multiplied into the surface, the room's light on it

type_voices.name: note
type_voices.use: doodles and annotations near what they point at

type_voices.name: card
type_voices.use: glass cards on a fingertip; one fact

colour_world.rule: the room's own colour, graded gently; punctuation is the room itself (a word behind an object, light on a silhouette)

budgets.sfx: approved library only, where earned, never default

footage_quotas.surfaces: at least two of floor / desk / wall measured (planes.h)
footage_quotas.objects: at least one foreground object the speaker can stand behind
footage_quotas.hands: one raised-hand moment for a fingertip card
footage_quotas.missing: plan_footage, then the acquisition dialogue (at most 3 options with cost and time); never 'not possible'
